objective: A long filename loses its extension in the storage key and its content type. server/services/storage/keys.ts ~L63 safeSegment returns cleaned.slice(0, 180), so a 193-character '... 2026 edition.pdf' ends 'records sources 202' and contentTypeFor gives application/octet-stream; server/services/storage.ts ~L340 claims the extension survives. Fix in safeSegment: when truncating, keep path.extname (up to 8 characters) and truncate only the stem so the result is at most 180 characters, re-stripping trailing dots/spaces from the stem. Short names must be byte-identical to before.
expectedOutcome: Truncated storage segments keep their extension.

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/storageKeyLongFilename.test.ts: a 250-character '.pdf' name yields a segment of at most 180 characters ending '.pdf', and contentTypeFor on it returns application/pdf.
Names under the limit are returned byte-identical to the previous behaviour.
Existing storage key tests pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
